question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Peculiar
solution:
```html

The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Peculiar"** means something that is strange or unusual, often in a way that is interesting or attractive. (अजीब)
 
 
• **Example: **She has a peculiar habit of collecting old keys.
 
 
 
• **"Strange"** refers to something that is unusual or surprising, difficult to understand or explain. (अजीब)
 
 
• **Example: **The house had a strange atmosphere that made me feel uneasy.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Peculiar'** is **'Strange'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Neat** (साफ-सुथरा): Arranged in an orderly, tidy way.
 
 
• **Example:** His handwriting is very neat and easy to read.
 
 
 
• **Normal** (सामान्य): Conforming to a standard; usual, typical, or expected.
 
 
• **Example:** It's normal to feel nervous before an exam.
 
 
 
• **Jovial** (प्रसन्न): Cheerful and friendly.
 
 
• **Example:** He is a jovial person who always has a smile on his face.
```
